html:
Perks › Rare

Jackpot Ends

Rare perk · Scoring bonus

A scoring play with an open-end total of at least 25 adds 20 points.

In-game card text

How it works

A scoring play whose open ends add up to 25 or more gains +20 points for each copy.

At a glance

RarityRare
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 600 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Uncommon perks.
